settings.heading: Details & Materials
settings.content: 100% full-grain calfskin leather, drum-dyed for enduring softness. Lined in breathable micro-suede. Custom solid brass magnetic hardware.

settings.heading: Dimensions & Fit
settings.content: Width: 26 cm (10.2 in) · Height: 15 cm (5.9 in) · Depth: 7 cm (2.8 in). Shoulder strap drop: 28 cm (11.0 in). Weight: 380 grams.

settings.heading: Care Guide
settings.content: Wipe gently with a soft dry cloth. Store in the complimentary organic cotton dust bag away from direct sunlight. Treat with natural leather balm twice annually.

settings.heading: Shipping & Complimentary Returns
settings.content: Complimentary standard shipping on orders over $150. Domestic orders arrive within 2–4 business days. 30-day return window with prepaid return shipping.

settings.title: Full-Grain Italian Calfskin
settings.text: Sourced from small family-run tanneries in Tuscany. Supple to the touch with a delicate pebble grain that develops a rich patina.

settings.title: Unstructured Ergonomic Slouch
settings.text: Drapes naturally under the arm without rigid cardboard stiffeners. Soft yet structured enough to stand on its base when set down.

settings.title: Custom Solid Brass Hardware
settings.text: Every buckle and magnetic closure is machined from solid brass and brushed to a warm satin finish that will never peel or rust.

settings.title: Reinforced Saddle Stitching
settings.text: Critical stress points are hand-tacked with high-tensile waxed thread, ensuring the shoulder strap remains secure through years of daily commute.

settings.heading: Why We Made It
settings.subhead: No extraneous hardware. No conspicuous logos. Just considered proportions and honest materials.

settings.heading: The Integrity of Every Seam
settings.subhead: Every millimeter inspected by hand before leaving our studio workshop.

settings.heading: Everything You Need. Nothing You Don't.
settings.subhead: Engineered to hold daily essentials without bulging or compromising its clean architectural drape.

settings.question: Will my phone fit inside the bag?
settings.answer: Yes. The bag easily accommodates all modern smartphones up to the iPhone 15 Pro Max and Galaxy Ultra.

settings.question: Is the leather water resistant?
settings.answer: Our full-grain leather is naturally resilient to light humidity. Blot gently with a dry cotton cloth if exposed to rain.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.subhead: Straightforward answers regarding sizing, leather care, and shipping.
